{{Quote|If it's supposed to bake hard, then how do they use it as dry rations? They couldn't get that in a backpack.''"<br />"''You roll it up before you cook it. Then you soak it in water to make it soft again.|[[Besany Wennen]] and [[Ruusaan Skirata]]|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
'''''Haarshun'' bread''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-made [[Bread/Legends|bread]]. The name ''haarshun'' was from the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], and while ''haarshun'' bread was colloquially translated to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] as "[[Flimsiplast/Legends|parchment]] bread," a more literal translation would be "[[Eye/Legends|see]]-bread." The etymology of the word was derived from the process of the bread's creation:<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> ''haarshun'' bread dough was rolled out extremely thin, to the extent than an individual was able to see through the dough when held up to a light source. The flattened dough was then rolled up, and baked dry. In this form, ''haarshun'' bread became commonplace in Mandalorian dry [[Food rations|rations]]; when it came [[Time/Legends|time]] to eat the hardened bread, it was soaked in [[Water/Legends|water]] to regain its edible softness.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

A few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Mandalorian [[Besany Wennen]] made ''haarshun'' bread and other dishes with several members of [[Clan Skirata]], for an informal celebration of the coming of [[Spring/Legends|spring]] in the north of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The former Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Rav Bralor]], believed that ''haarshun'' bread should be rolled thin enough for an individual to see their [[Marriage/Legends|betrothal]] ring through the dough.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Haarshun'' bread first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]] by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> On Traviss's personal website, she referred to the bread as "haashun."<ref name="Dictionary">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/downloads/index.html|text=Dictionary|work=[https://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20111125225842|nolive=1}}</ref>
